name: Ozan Yücel Local SEO for Türkiye
author: Ozan Yücel

sections.description:
Most local SEO and schema plugins assume a US or UK address. Turkish businesses end up with the province in the “state” field, the district missing, and phone numbers like “0232 123 45 67” that Google cannot read. This plugin is built only for businesses in Türkiye, so the structured data matches how Turkish addresses and phone numbers actually work.

LocalBusiness schema for Türkiye

  • Address fields in Turkish order: neighbourhood and street (Mahalle, Cadde/Sokak, No), district (ilçe), province (il) and postal code, mapped correctly to schema.org PostalAddress with country TR.
  • Turkish phone numbers in any format (0232…, 0546…, 90…, with or without spaces) are converted to the international +90 format Google expects.
  • Business types common in Turkish local search: dental clinics, hair and beauty salons, car services, real estate agencies, law offices, hotels and guesthouses, jewellery stores and more.
  • Service areas as a simple list of districts (e.g. Karşıyaka, Bornova, Bayraklı).
  • Opening hours, map link, coordinates, logo, image and social profiles.
  • Output as JSON-LD on the home page, with a live preview and a one-click Google Rich Results test.

llms.txt for AI search

The plugin can also serve yoursite.com/llms.txt, a plain Markdown summary of your business for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity. Unlike general llms.txt generators, it starts with your Turkish business details (address, +90 phone, service districts) taken from the same settings as the schema, so both signals always match.

  • Choose which content types appear (pages, posts, products or any public post type).
  • Pages marked noindex in Yoast SEO or Rank Math are skipped automatically.
  • Exclude individual pages by ID.
  • Cached and refreshed whenever you publish or update content.

Privacy

No external requests, no tracking, no ads, no account needed. Developer filters: lslt_llms_txt and lslt_schema.

The interface is translation-ready; translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org.

Made in İzmir by Ozan Yücel, web design, SEO, AEO and GEO consultant.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the ozan-yucel-local-seo-for-turkiye folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Settings > Local Schema & llms.txt.
  4. Write a short summary of your business, pick the content to list and save. Open yoursite.com/llms.txt to check it.
  5. Fill in the LocalBusiness fields exactly as they appear on your Google Business Profile, tick “Add schema” and save. Use “Test with Google” to validate.
sections.faq:
My llms.txt shows a 404

The file needs pretty permalinks. Under Settings > Permalinks choose any structure other than “Plain” and save once.

My site already has an llms.txt file

If a real llms.txt file exists in your site root, your web server shows that file and this plugin’s version is not used. The settings screen warns you when this happens. Delete or rename the old file to use the generated one. If another plugin (for example Yoast SEO or Rank Math) also generates llms.txt, turn off “Serve llms.txt” in one of them.

Will the schema conflict with my SEO plugin?

Most SEO plugins output Organization or WebSite schema. This plugin adds a separate LocalBusiness block on the home page only. If your SEO plugin already outputs LocalBusiness with the same details, keep only one of them.

Does the plugin contact any external service?

No. Everything is generated on your own site.

Can I use it outside Türkiye?

Yes, but the address country is set to TR and phone numbers are normalised for Türkiye. Use the lslt_schema filter to adjust.
